findings.evidence: `PathSpace/Law/Extreme.lean:84` defines `private theorem exchangeableLaw_bind_infinitePi`; lines 153, 156, and 250 use it, while `PathSpace/Law/Extreme.lean:103-120` and `PathSpace/HewittSavage.lean:398-410` contain the same `iIndepFun_infinitePi`/`IdentDistrib` coordinate setup repeated here at lines 232-245.
findings.fix: Move `exchangeableLaw_bind_infinitePi` to a shared lower-level module as public API, derive this theorem by binding a Dirac measure (using `Measure.dirac_bind`), and update the existing consumers to reuse it.
